audio.pitch: native fixed voice; no pitch shift
audio.line_synthesis: independent lines; upstream silence trim enabled

normalization.method: whole-waveform RMS, peak-limited linear gain; PCM16 quantization

encoder.mapping: min(4 * frame RMS, 0.8) equally into upstream ear_cells

response.units: spikes per second per neuron (Hz/neuron), unless stated otherwise

measurement_rules.transition_rule: outside max(3 baseline smoothed SD, 0.02 Hz/neuron) for 60 ms
measurement_rules.recovery_rule: first 200 ms continuously within that band; null = not observed in tail
measurement_rules.population_rank: absolute audio-minus-baseline mean Hz per neuron; no minimum group size
measurement_rules.warning: Descriptive single-run changes, not statistical significance or behavioral observations.

reading.text: Against an equally long silence, the voice shifts mean activity above the control by 0.011 Hz per neuron. Its greatest global separation occurs at 9.28 seconds. The emphasis belongs to this difference, rather than to activity the instrument would have produced anyway. The largest mean cell-type difference is in JO-A (24 neurons, +12.03 Hz per neuron). In the recorded aftermath, the mean difference is +0.004 Hz per neuron. The end can be read as an interval of separation from silence; this single paired run does not establish a stable disposition.
reading.status: Interpretation of a model counterfactual, not cognition or observed behavior

provenance.poem_rerun_validation: All 1434 global timestep spike counts exactly reproduce the original saved poem run.

display.poem:
Little fly,
Thy summer’s play
My thoughtless hand
Has brushed away.

Am not I
A fly like thee?
Or art not thou
A man like me?

For I dance
And drink and sing,
Till some blind hand
Shall brush my wing.

If thought is life
And strength and breath,
And the want
Of thought is death,

Then am I
A happy fly,
If I live,
Or if I die.
display.note: Display-only text. Never passed to simulator or interpreter.

rules.control: Same seed, reset, duration and parameters; every auditory injection is zero.
rules.smoothing: Causal 100 ms mean for traces and peak; unsmoothed phase means for rates.
rules.ranking: Absolute poem minus matched silence mean Hz/neuron; includes small populations.
rules.limitation: One paired seed. A model counterfactual, not a population norm, significance test or evidence of language processing.
